g.title: G
g.text: DOWNSTREAM | Actual scoring heads, shared modules and auxiliary path
Current Large residual_feature, blend=0. Same [ID] = same parameter object

g.title: cluster_align
g.text: C. Align scoring heads | no NSS injection here

g.title: cluster_bank
g.text: D. Auxiliary Quality text head | NOT a final-score head

g.title: p0
g.text: SAME L weights in Q/Align calls

g.title: diag
g.text: SAME [QG] also evaluates z and a

g.title: ev
g.text: weighted sum of AP output -> e

g.title: bnote
g.text: blend=0: no score mixing into Quality
Does NOT pass through U or text_projector

g.title: note
g.text: SHARING: AG / AT / AP are independent adapters; AHG / AHP independent heads.
PQ, PI, PT and DQ, DI, DT are PRETRAINING modules, not downstream SimSiam heads.
QG/QP/NG/N/L/XI/XT/AHG/AHP/G exist downstream but are reset in representation scope.
Legacy s_final computed using fusion_logit, not supervised; no independent Final regression head.
Optional text_gate / extra attention / V-Mamba / distribution / Align bank / HA-HE are OFF.
